description:
Doug climbs the ocean food chain one predator at a time, dressed as each one's favourite prey: a mantis shrimp whose punch hits twice, a moray with a second set of jaws, a fish that catches birds in mid-air, the polar bear, the great white, the sperm whale, and the orca, the top predator that even great white sharks flee from.

Which predator should Doug meet next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
